summary: "已读懂" moves from the recommendation card and the today detail pane to the library: a paper must be saved first, then it can be marked understood as a button in each library list row, beside 详情 and 编辑类别 (organization snapshot items now carry understood_in: the projects whose latest familiarity label is understood) (recorded in the viewed project tab, or the current project under 全部). record_feedback now refuses 'understood' for a paper the project has not saved. The weekly report's "返回画像" link goes to the profile tab (/?view=profile&project_id=...) instead of the home page; index.html opens the tab named by ?view=. The learning-map page text now says to save first, then mark it in the library.
scope_note: Branch main; the route-growth work lives in its own worktree and is not touched.

budget_impact.rationale: A validation rule, a button moved and a link changed; no model call, no network, nothing new stored.
budget_impact.before: understood could be marked on an unsaved paper from the card or the today detail pane
budget_impact.after: understood is marked in the library on a saved paper only
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

open_risks: The library row button and the back link were covered by tests only; the layout was not looked at in a running app.
Papers already marked understood before this change stay marked, even if unsaved; only new marks are refused.
